literal_meaning: তুলার পাল্লা দেওয়া (balance scales-এর মতো ওজন করা বা মাপা)
figurative_meaning_en: to compete or vie with someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: খেলায় তারা পাল্লা দিয়ে জিততে চায়।
example_sentences_in_english: The two brothers are competing in business.
In the game, they are vying to win against each other.
note: This idiom draws from the imagery of balancing scales, symbolizing equal footing in competition.
